content_data.meeting_title: UX Strategy Alignment for 'EuroVoyage Reimagined' Project
agenda_items: Planning next steps for usability testing and A/B variant creation
Feedback on high-fidelity wireframes for destination discovery feature
Discussion on visual design language consistency across new platform modules
key_decisions: Confirmed the need for user testing with a diverse European audience within the next few weeks.
Agreed to prioritize mobile-first design for the initial launch phase of the new booking platform.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The meeting was about UX Strategy Alignment for the 'EuroVoyage Reimagined' Project.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The agenda included planning next steps for usability testing and A/B variant creation, feedback on high-fidelity wireframes for the destination discovery feature, and a discussion on visual design language consistency across new platform modules.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We confirmed the need for user testing with a diverse European audience within the next few weeks and agreed to prioritize mobile-first design for the initial launch phase of the new booking platform.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Elena Petrova, our Creative Director, Isabelle Dubois, Product Owner for Digital Travel, and Ravi Sharma, Senior UX Designer, were all in attendance.
